AI Engineer

Experience

4 to 12 years of software engineering experience with hands-on experience in AI/GenAI application development
Experience building and deploying AI-enabled products, platforms, or enterprise solutions
Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience across backend systems, APIs, and cloud-native applications
Experience leading small teams or driving delivery across multiple engineers/workstreams
Comfortable working with Product, Engineering, and Architecture stakeholders

GenAI & Agentic Development

Design and build GenAI applications using frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, or similar
Develop RAG-based solutions including ingestion, retrieval, orchestration, and response generation
Build agentic workflows involving tool usage, memory, and multi-step task execution
Integrate LLMs and AI services into enterprise applications and business processes
Drive adoption of AI-native engineering practices within the team

Technical Skills

Strong programming skills in Python and modern software engineering frameworks
Experience with LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent
Experience building APIs, microservices, and cloud-native applications
Familiarity with vector databases, retrieval systems, and prompt engineering techniques
Working knowledge of CI/CD, containers, and cloud deployment practices

Delivery & Team Leadership

Lead delivery of AI engineering workstreams and key product features
Mentor and guide engineers on solution design, coding practices, and AI adoption
Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions
Drive engineering quality, delivery predictability, and operational excellence

AI Engineering Practices

Define and promote best practices around prompt design, model evaluation, and AI application development
Leverage AI tools to improve engineering productivity and speed of delivery
Stay current with emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to apply them within products

Role & responsibilities





7+ years of experience in AI/ML or Software Engineering for senior level / 5+ years of experience for mid-level

Proficiency in Python (FastAPI / Flask).
Deep knowledge of AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, DynamoDB, AWS S3)
Strong knowledge of AWS Bedrock, LLM and prompt engineering.
Familiarity with GitHub REST APIs, OpenAPI specs, and JSON schema design.
Understanding of secure coding, linting, and PR automation
Experience building autonomous AI agents along with Knowledgebase, guardrails & action groups.
AI Engineer designs, builds, and deploys AI/ML models and LLM-based applications (chatbots, document processing, predictive analytics) -Experience in cloud GCP and AWD Cloud (Exp. 7 - 10 yrs)

Role Responsibilities:
Design and build asynchronous, production-grade AI/ML pipelines integrating autonomous coding agents
Develop code intelligence systems using AST/CST parsing and vector-based retrieval over large repositories
Integrate LLMs and agent frameworks to enable autonomous coding and repository-level reasoning
Build scalable, high-throughput backend systems in Python
Containerize and manage complex ML environments using Docker and multi-container setups
Write and maintain comprehensive automated tests to ensure reliability and correctness
Enforce high standards for code quality, abstraction, and maintainability

Must-Have Qualifications



2+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, backend systems, or developer tooling
Strong Python expertise, including concurrency and performance-oriented programming
Hands-on experience with coding agents (e g , Cursor CLI, OpenHands, Aider) and autonomous reasoning loops
Proficiency in AST/CST parsing (Tree-sitter, LibCST) and large codebase indexing
Experience building RAG pipelines using vector databases such as ChromaDB
Extensive experience with Docker for containerizing and managing ML systems
Strong testing discipline with Pytest, PEP 8 compliance, and type hinting
Proven ability to conduct rigorous PR reviews and identify architectural, security, and performance issues
Experience with prompt engineering and agent optimization

The team





Deloittes Technology & Transformation practice can help organizations uncover and unlock value through innovative technology, data, cloud, and AI solutions. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services that help businesses modernize their technology landscape, build scalable digital platforms, and accelerate AI-led transformation. Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities across cloud, data, artificial intelligence, analytics, software engineering, and next-generation technologies.

Deloitte is building an Agentic Platform & Applications for the enterprise the backend infrastructure that enables businesses to create, deploy, integrate, and operate AI agents at scale in a regulated fintech environment.





Your work profile





We are seeking a strong backend/platform engineer to build and scale the core infrastructure powering enterprise AI agents and applications. The ideal candidate will have solid software engineering fundamentals, experience with distributed systems and cloud-native architectures, and an interest in building production-grade AI agent platforms.





The role will involve:





Building backend services for agent creation, configuration, deployment, execution, sessions, state, memory, and lifecycle the full runtime stack.

Designing and implementing agent and service orchestration capabilities, including asynchronous processing, routing, retries, timeouts, and reliable error handling across multi-agent workflows.

Integrating LLMs, Agent SDKs such as Google ADK and LangGraph, MCP services, and A2A agents through clean, scalable platform APIs.

Connecting AI agents with enterprise applications and services through scalable and versioned APIs.

Building end-to-end production observability using OpenTelemetry, including tracing across agent, model, tool, and service execution.

Deploying and operating platform services on Kubernetes / GKE / GCP with appropriate security, CI/CD, scalability, and production reliability practices.

Working closely with architects, engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders to design and deliver scalable enterprise AI capabilities.

Taking end-to-end ownership of platform components, from design and development through deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.





Key skills required





4-6 years of solid experience in backend or platform engineering.

Strong programming experience in Python, with hands-on experience building production-grade backend services using FastAPI or similar frameworks.

Strong understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous programming, microservices, REST APIs, and scalable backend architectures.

Experience building APIs, developer platforms, orchestration systems, or distributed applications. Experience in AI is beneficial but not mandatory if the candidate has strong transferable platform engineering experience.

Some hands-on exposure to AI agents, Agent SDKs, MCP, A2A, LLM-based applications, or related AI technologies.

Experience with cloud-native architecture and deployment on GCP / GKE, Kubernetes, and Docker.

Understanding of CI/CD, authentication, security, production reliability, and cloud infrastructure practices.

Experience with production observability, distributed tracing, and tools such as OpenTelemetry, OPIK, or Langfuse.

Strong understanding of databases and data stores, including PostgreSQL, Redis, and familiarity with vector databases.

Strong problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and ownership mindset.

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and take end-to-end ownership of technical deliverables.
